scope.firmware_basis: official-v15 plus recorded H0/H1/H2 evidence, with H2 as the live parent

inputs.role: existing live-proven H2 artifact, read only
recovered official-v15 sbrk HEAP_BEGIN and HEAP_END

layout.purpose: slot 0 immutable voice; exact live-proven H2 source
global set_state; 0 means fallback/unarmed, exactly 1 means both slots and both note bytes are immutable and armed; exact H2 valid address
global nonblocking producer lock; exact H2 lock address
zero reserved tail retaining the required second 0xa0 stride

rules: producer takes the H2 nonblocking lock
state remains 0 while validating notes and copying both complete 0x9c payloads
reject note values above 127 and reject equal note values
write both note bytes before publication
execute csync and write state 1 last
reject every mutation after state becomes 1 until reboot
consumers never lock and use stock fallback unless state is exactly 1

lookup: if channel is not Ch10, use stock fallback
if state is not exactly 1, use stock fallback
else if note equals note_slot1, use 0x01c465c0
minimum_two_note_layout.minimality: The two fixed note bytes encode the complete two-entry map, state doubles as H2-compatible valid-last publication, and the H2 lock is retained. These four bytes exactly fill slot 0's 0x9c..0x9f tail, so no header or third range is required.

instruction_patches.meaning: BSS zero size 0x3cb48 -> 0x3cc8c; relative to H2 0x3cbec -> 0x3cc8c

h0.establishes: The H2-sized 0xa0 BSS/HEAP boundary change alone did not cause an immediate reboot on the tested first stock Pad event.
h0.does_not_establish: heap high-water, long-duration allocator safety, or the additional 0xa0 loss required by S1-C1

h1.establishes: The same H2 boundary tolerated the accepted-packet producer and a 0x9c write/publication under the tested sequence.
h1.does_not_establish: any larger boundary or second-slot allocation

h2.establishes: The same H2 boundary tolerated live consumption of slot 0 at the exact retained addresses after fallback correction.
h2.does_not_establish: allocator headroom after moving HEAP_BEGIN another 0xa0 or two-slot selector behavior

headroom_gate.strict_sbrk_rule: A positive increment ending at or beyond HEAP_END is rejected.
offline_pass_condition: Use exact H2 allocator/sbrk semantics and an allocation trace or complete allocation/lifetime model covering the admitted worst-case workload.
Let Bmax be the greatest H2 current-break endpoint reached by any successful positive sbrk increment. Require Bmax + 0xa0 < 0x01c7fd30.
Replay every H2 successful increment with the initial break advanced by 0xa0 and prove every result remains successful in the same order.
Account for allocator alignment, headers, fragmentation, concurrent task stacks, and every allocation failure path. Aggregate free-byte totals alone do not pass.

paired_live_gate_if_offline_proof_is_inc.baseline: exact H2 with fixed, nonallocating telemetry
paired_live_gate_if_offline_proof_is_inc.test_arm: same telemetry and H2 behavior, changing only BSS size 0x3cbec -> 0x3cc8c and HEAP_BEGIN 0x01c465c0 -> 0x01c46660; do not access slot 1
workload: Ch1 control before, during, and after Ch10 activity
repeated and overlapping Ch10 Note On/Off including reversed release order
all existing nonpersistent S1-C1 guard paths
pass_condition: identical successful allocation/sbrk result sequence in both arms
no new allocation failure, null return, reboot, hang, audio guard failure, or reconnect failure
the boundary-only arm retains strictly positive measured headroom at its worst point

gates.reason: Two exact 0xa0 strides occupy 0x01c46520..0x01c46660, and paired BSS/HEAP_BEGIN changes constructively exclude allocator alias.
Slot 0 voice, state/valid, and lock remain at 0x01c46520, 0x01c465bc, and 0x01c465bd.
Four global bytes are sufficient for immutable all-or-none publication and two exact note comparisons; they fit the retained slot-0 tail.
H0/H1/H2 defend the existing one-slot 0xa0 boundary only for their recorded smoke sequences.
No recorded max-break trace or complete allocator/lifetime model proves the strict Bmax + 0xa0 < HEAP_END condition.
The additional offline/paired-live headroom gate must pass first; other S1-C1 code/parser/note-ABI gates remain outside this RAM-only analysis.
